description: Expander for Spellbook carrying sixteen more columns of its sequence; it goes immediately to the right of a Spellbook or of another Page

outputs.text: The sixteen columns this expander carries, together on one cable
One of the sixteen columns this expander carries: the first Page after a Spellbook carries columns 17 to 32, and each further Page the sixteen columns after that

notes: with no Spellbook or Page to its left this module has nothing to carry, and every output stays at 0V.
the voltages arrive already worked out by the Spellbook, so clock, reset, index and the sequence text all belong to that module; this one has no controls of its own.
